Hi Olga,

We're ready to receive the invoice for PO-4832 (Acme Analytics — Redwood purchase). A couple of asks from AP to ensure a smooth payment run: 

- Invoice must be issued to: Acme Analytics Ltd (EU entity) and include our PO number PO-4832 on the invoice header.
- We prefer e-invoicing via your portal (we can accept a PDF by email as fallback). If you have a portal onboarding link, please send it and we will opt in.
- VAT: please include the invoice-level VAT amount and a copy of Redwood's VAT/EIN so our tax team can reconcile.
- Payment: we will pay by SEPA; please confirm you can accept SEPA and whether you need a signed mandate.

If it helps, I can loop in our AP contact at accounts-payable@acme.com for document upload.

Thanks,

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. 

Short answer: yes, we can support portal-first e-invoicing and provide the VAT/EIN evidence. Below is how we'd like to proceed so we have a single point of truth and avoid duplicate sends to AP: 

Option A — Portal (recommended)
- We create the invoice in Redwood Billing and push it to our customer portal.
- Your AP team can opt in and we will add accounts-payable@acme.com as a delivery copy (email notification + portal PDF).
- VAT/EIN evidence: we will attach a tax certificate to the portal invoice metadata.
- SEPA: we accept SEPA; I am attaching a SEPA mandate template for your records (SEPA_mandate_template.pdf).

Option B — Email PDF (fallback)
- We can generate a signed PDF and email to accounts-payable@acme.com if portal onboarding is not completed before AP cutoff.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm portal opt-in (Option A) and the exact AP inbox to cc.
2) Confirm the legal billing name + VAT/EIN you want on the invoice (you wrote Acme Analytics Ltd; confirm the registered number).
3) If SEPA requires a signed mandate on your side, return the signed SEPA PDF to me and we will mark it on file.

Connor — looped you in to align on the invoice generation mapping (entity, VAT, PO field). Marissa — if you can take the invoice issuance once Tom confirms, that would be great.

Best,

Thanks — quick operational notes below (copying AP ops and billing team).

- Invoice metadata: we will populate the "Bill To" as the legal entity you confirm and include PO-4832 in the Invoice Number/Reference field. That ensures downstream AP matching.
- VAT evidence: we'll attach your requested VAT certificate to the portal record; if you need a separate PDF on the invoice, say so and we will bake it into the PDF.
- Portal opt-in: once accounts-payable@acme.com confirms opt-in, the portal will send an automated notification and provide download/archival. If you prefer an email copy each invoice, we can toggle a delivery rule per account.
- SEPA: we require a signed mandate for recurring SEPA pulls. For one-off invoice payment by SEPA transfer, the mandate is optional but recommended.

Marissa — when Tom confirms, can you: (1) create the invoice in the billing console under the Acme Analytics Ltd entity; (2) add the VAT/EIN evidence file to the invoice metadata; (3) set delivery rule to portal + copy to accounts-payable@acme.com.

Tom — if you can reply with: (A) confirmed legal name + VAT/EIN, (B) confirmation of portal opt-in, and (C) whether you'll return a signed SEPA mandate, we'll generate and route the invoice end-to-end.

--
